$comment: Single source of truth for @zoijs/core compatibility floors (SEC-7), enforced by scripts/release-check.mjs.

capabilities: the FIRST published @zoijs/core version providing an import (a subpath, or 'subpath#export' when a named export arrived later than its subpath). Verified against the published tarballs on npm.

'next' = ships in the next core release, which has no version yet. Packages/templates that need a 'next' capability cannot be released until nextCore is set to the version that release will carry (then raise their floors to it).
securityFloor: the lowest published core with every known security fix — generated apps must not allow anything older.
When a core release ships: set nextCore to its version, replace 'next' entries with it, then clear nextCore after publishing.
